snippet.title: Inari's Tale Gameplay Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Inari's Tale is a 2D story-driven hand-drawn action-puzzle-platformer. The story is set during the mythical origins of Japan. You play Inari, starting as a tadpole. As you progress in the story, you grow limbs and add to your skills. Don't get fooled by the mellow art style and the simple mechanics, there are plenty of challenges, secrets to unlock, collectibles to gather, and player skins to use.

Inari's Tale is a solo dev project built in Construct3. It is focused on providing a visually impactful experience with Minimal UI and fitting music to allow for full immersion. 

Play the demo and Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1779120/Inaris_Tale/
